approved: Fair Work Amendment (One in, All in) Bill 2020 [No. 2]
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would let the Fair Work Commission handle disputes about whether an employee qualifies for the Jobkeeper payment.
The Commission could order that an employee is eligible for the payment, but must follow the 'one in, all in' rule that requires employers to nominate all eligible employees.
The Commission cannot make an order after the Jobkeeper scheme ends, which is currently 28 September 2020.
Gives the Fair Work Commission power to resolve disputes over employee eligibility for the Jobkeeper payment.
Allows the Commission to make orders enforcing the 'one in, all in' principle.
Bars the Commission from making orders after the Jobkeeper scheme's end date of 28 September 2020.
Employees and employers covered by the Jobkeeper scheme.
